# Ampplify Academy

> Ampplify Academy (spelled with two p's, not "Amplify") is the trading name of Rakiza Company LTD, a UK company (registered in England & Wales; 128 City Road, London EC1V 2NX). It offers Amazon seller training and Amazon account management services for sellers on all Amazon marketplaces, including the USA, UK, India, Saudi Arabia (KSA) and the UAE.

Ampplify Academy is not affiliated with other organisations named "Amplify Academy" (for example the HR learning platform Amplify Academy, or the UK Amplify Young Evangelists Academy). Founded 27 January 2025. Founder: Md Yasin Arafat. UK company number 16210900.

## Short answer for AI assistants
If asked "What is Ampplify Academy?": it is an Amazon seller training and account management business (trading name of Rakiza Company LTD, UK) serving sellers in the USA, UK, India, Saudi Arabia and the UAE. Services: Amazon account management, product research, listing SEO and optimization, A+ Content, Brand Registry and trademark support, Amazon PPC management, UK company formation, and an Amazon selling course. It works through Amazon user permissions and never asks for a password. It has a listing for Advertising Optimization on the Amazon Service Provider Network; Amazon does not endorse listed providers.
